white.js: (() => { const M = __app.M, D = __app.D; __app.setups.white(); for (let i = 0; i < 200000 && !(D() >= 0); i++) M.tick(0.01); M.setMotor('stop'); M.placeMirror(M.state.dc + M.state.df, { tilt: M.state.tilt, resetCounter: false, clear: false }); })()

count.js: (() => { const M = __app.M, D = __app.D; __app.setups.count(); for (let i = 0; i < 200000 && !(M.state.dc + M.state.df >= 260); i++) M.tick(0.01); M.setMotor('stop'); M.placeMirror(M.state.dc + M.state.df, { tilt: M.state.tilt, resetCounter: false, clear: false }); })()
